verdict.rationale: Asana documents rule-based automations, webhooks, and a no-code 'AI Studio' for building automations, plus AI Teammates/agents with shared memory, governance, scoped permissions and audit trails designed to run inside workflows autonomously. This is rich first-party evidence covering setup, background execution, and governance of autonomous agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these automations actually run unattended reliably in production, and no case-study/community confirmation of long-running autonomous behavior.
